activity_summary: Garnish pasted the slip and said you had mended the play to fit the player, which was against nature. You said it was cheaper than a new player. Cowley heard "and that is enough" and claimed it. Heminges counted one slip and one player kept. Burbage asked for nothing new. There was no bill, and the house was not opened. Larkham did not copy a second book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ordered the paste and gave the cheapness as the reason.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Pasted the slip and named the offence against nature.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Heard the new end and took the next miss on himself.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted the slip as one, and sent you toward the table.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Refused a second size, and told Garnish to paste before a beauty returned.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Heard. He was not given a rival copy.

facets.activity: Let Garnish paste the slip and called it cheaper than a new player

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: You have mended the play to fit the player. It is against nature.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It's cheaper than a new player.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Easter Monday is a date, not a mood.
